lines: Main jaanta hoon jo woh likhenge jawaab mein
couplets.en: I know what they will write in reply.

lines: Kab se hoon, kya bataaun, jahaan-e-kharaab mein
couplets.en: How long have I been in this broken world?

lines: Shab-haaye hijr ko bhi rakhoon gar hisaab mein
couplets.en: That is, if I count the nights we spent apart.

lines: Mujh tak kab un ki bazm mein aata tha daur-e-jaam
couplets.en: When did the cup ever make its way to me at their gathering?

lines: Saaqi ne kuchh mila na diya ho sharaab mein
couplets.en: Perhaps the cupbearer slipped something into the wine.

lines: Ta phir na intizaar mein neend aaye umr bhar
couplets.en: So that waiting may keep me awake for the rest of my life.

lines: Aane ka ahd kar gaye, aaye jo khwaab mein
couplets.en: When they came to me in a dream, they promised to come again.

lines: Ghalib, chhuti sharaab, par ab bhi kabhi kabhi
couplets.en: Ghalib, I gave up wine, though even now, now and then.

lines: Peeta hoon roz-e-abr o shab-e-maahtaab mein
couplets.en: I drink on overcast days and moonlit nights.

lines: Kab se hoon, kya bataaun, jahaan-e-kharaab mein
couplets.en: How long have I been in this broken world?

lines: Shab-haaye hijr ko bhi rakhoon gar hisaab mein
couplets.en: That is, if I count the nights we spent apart.
